text: I waited an hour for a 20-minute procedure. Everything was going so well until I encountered this clinic. I'm extremely disappointed. I had an appointment on Saturday, the 6th, at 3:00 PM. Upon arrival, I gave my name and the staff asked if I was using social security insurance. I forgot my ID card, so they said it was okay. After putting me on the waiting list, I sat and waited. After a while, a staff member came and informed me that there were two people ahead of me and I would have to wait about half an hour. (I was confused; I had an appointment, so why did I have to wait?) But I didn't mind, thinking half an hour was manageable. During that time, I overheard a staff member talking to another customer, saying that if I wanted a scaling and polishing, they could skip the queue a little (?). I thought, "They're not going to skip my turn, are they?" Half an hour passed, and my name wasn't called. An hour passed, and still no one called my name. I couldn't take it anymore and decided to cancel because I had other things to do and didn't have time to wait. I went to the staff and said, "I'd like to cancel the scaling procedure because I've already waited an hour." The staff member immediately said it was ready and told me to wait on the 3rd floor. Honestly, I didn't want to do it anymore; I was so disappointed. Then the staff member let me into the room for the procedure. In the end, it was finished in 20 minutes. The dentist was very heavy-handed and it hurt a lot. There was no sensitivity, but it was painful. After the procedure, I touched my inner molar and there was still plaque stuck to it. I went to pay, but the staff said I couldn't use social security insurance without my ID card (not complaining, but why didn't they tell me that from the start?). Whatever! Just tell me how much it is, I want to pay and leave this clinic. 1200 baht or whatever, just say it. I'm tired of being here. In the end, the clinic gave a 10% discount because it was my first time, so I paid 1080 baht. And they even dared to schedule another appointment for a filling! I'm done! I want to go somewhere better. I was cheerful all morning, but arriving at the clinic made me irritable all day.
author_name: นักรีวิวตัวยง
